relationship_to_prior: Materially different post-closeout hypothesis. 2023-2024 is contaminated development history and is forbidden as confirmation evidence. This gate inspects only the disjoint 2025 block for source adequacy; 2026 remains locked.
scientific_question: Does the disjoint 2025 BTCDVOL monthly-futures population contain enough adjacent-contract overlap and simultaneous ordinary public trading activity to support a one-shot relative-basis calendar-spread test?

pair_construction.contract_population: Exact valid BTCDVOL futures discovered by deterministic Wednesday enumeration in 2025.
pair_construction.pair_rule: Sort exact confirmed contracts by expiration_timestamp and pair adjacent expiries only.

ordinary_trade_rule: Deduplicate by trade_id; exclude block trades, block RFQ and combo trades.
retained_metrics_only: ordinary public trade count each leg
unique active UTC days each leg
stop_rule: If any source gate fails, stop. Do not lower thresholds, select denser pairs, widen beyond exact listed-life overlap, add non-adjacent pairs, or open outcomes under this source gate ID.
post_pass_rule: PASS authorizes only a separately frozen 2025 relative-basis one-shot authority. It does not authorize use of 2023-2024 as confirmation evidence or access to 2026.
